about: Which ForgeVisual sight (Data/sights.json) an energy gun model wears instead of its own optic (ForgeVisual GunSights, embedded). at is where the middle of the sight's base stands, in the model's export frame (front +Z, metres, model size), on the rail under it; replace names the model's own optic parts. The other guns keep their own optics.

beam.about: 2x prism scope: the beam holds a line on a far target; in place of its holo-wedge sight
